intro: Sierra Leone has about 9 million people, famous for religious tolerance.

chapters.title: People
text: The Temne and Mende are the largest groups. English is official and Krio is spoken by almost everyone. Muslims and Christians live side by side, and mixed families are common.

chapters.title: Freetown
text: Freetown's Cotton Tree was a landmark for over 200 years until a storm felled it in 2023.

keyTerms.meaning: One of the largest ethnic groups.
